authoring_note: First attended-release forward session file. Permits only qualified ordinary sessions; holiday, shortened and uncertain adjacent sessions are denied as a book permission restriction, not as an assertion of exchange closure. Denied rows keep their identities and deadlines so account-session chronology and safe flattening are preserved. Immutable D19 and the typed closure overlay are separate artifacts.

venue.account_day_note: A Tradeify trading day spans 18:00 ET to 17:00 ET the next calendar day and is independent of the CME business trade date; holiday days are independent days.

sessions.denial_note: Columbus Day / Indigenous Peoples' Day. The CME Globex calendar shows regular Sunday 17:00 CT open and Monday 16:00 CT close for 6J, MGC, MYM and MNQ (cme-ui-columbus-2026), but CME lists a Columbus Day clearing advisory and settlement-times notice for 12 October whose contents were not captured, and Tradeify announces holiday hours only in Discord; denied as not positively qualified
